source: data/raw/doc/Plan Layout PFAL SISKU.pdf (Civic Agrotech, Rev. 0, tolerance +/-5 cm) — DESIGN intent, not as-built

room_design.note: as-built (scan): L 7.12, W 3.01, H 2.58 m -> built ~1.6-1.8 m shorter and 0.27 m lower

envelope.wall: PS foam sandwich panel 50 mm, white, density 1.00 lb/ft3 (Isowall)
envelope.roof: PU foam metal sheet 2 in, slope 2 deg, gutter
envelope.floor: concrete 240 ksc, 10 cm raised, PU coating 3 mm (maroon)
envelope.window_design: 1 viewing window W140 x H100 cm, sill 82 cm (as-built: 2 panes ~2.3 x 1.1 m facing the cafe)
envelope.door_design: PVC outdoor swing door 1 x 2 m (as-built: aluminium door with glass upper half)

electrical_loads_design.item: DC fan set (3 fans per growing layer)

supply: 30 A, 3 phase; consumer unit, kWh meter, WiFi router, Environment Control + IoT gateway near the door; 20 mm conduit; junction box feeding the tiers

lighting.led: white + red 660 nm LED modules, 42 W each, LED drivers on top of the rack

rack_design.layers: nursery 1 (NFT channels, 1 layer, door-end half of tier 1), nursery 2 (1 layer, far-end half of tier 1), growing stage 4 layers (tiers 2-5)
rack_design.fans: 3 DC fans per growing layer (15 sets)
rack_design.controls: fan control cabinet + Grow Controller at the far end of the rack

nutrient_design.growing_loop: pump in the 200 L tank -> supply riser at the DOOR end ('inlet circulation set', tees to 4 layers) -> trays -> return riser at the FAR end ('return pipe to tank') -> 200 L tank; sample pot (EC/pH) at the tank
nutrient_design.nursery2: dosing/control set mounted on the rack
nutrient_design.water: RO filter set + RO storage at the far end (outside the wall in the drawing), supply pump into the room

co2: 2 x 6Q CO2 cylinders outside (movable), CO2 dosing control cabinet must move with them
other_design_items: seed germination shelf at the far corner
